    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Barge
    Represents the Barge, the smallest ship in the fleet (equivalent to the submarine in traditional Battleship), occupying a single position on the board.
    Caravel
    Represents the Caravel, a 2-cell ship, corresponding to the 2-cannon ship in traditional Battleship.
    Carrack
    Represents the Carrack, a 3-cell ship, corresponding to the 3-cannon ship in traditional Battleship.
    Compass
    Enumeration representing the four cardinal bearings used to position ships on the board (NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST), including an UNKNOWN value for invalid or unrecognized bearings.
    Fleet
    Represents a player's fleet of ships in the Battleship game.
    Frigate
    Represents a frigate ("Fragata"), a ship that occupies 4 consecutive cells on the board, oriented either horizontally or vertically.
    Galleon
    Represents a galleon ("Galeao"), the largest ship in the fleet, occupying 5 cells arranged in an irregular, arrow-like shape rather than a straight line.
    Game
    Controls a single player's side of a Battleship match: it holds that player's IFleet, records every shot fired at it, and keeps running statistics about invalid shots, repeated shots, hits and sunk ships.
    IFleet
    Represents a fleet of ships in the Battleship game, responsible for managing the collection of ships placed on the board, validating their placement and querying their status.
    IGame
    Represents a Battleship game, responsible for processing shots fired at the fleet and keeping track of the game's statistics (hits, misses, invalid shots, repeated shots and sunk ships).
    IPosition
    Represents a position (cell) on a grid in the Battleship game, identified by a row and a column. * A position may be occupied by part of a ship and may already have been targeted by a shot, thus holding the state needed to progress the game.
    IShip
    Represents a ship in the Battleship game.
    Position
    Represents a concrete position (coordinate) on the Battleship game board.
    Ship
    Abstract base class representing a generic ship in the Battleship game.
    Tasks
    Utility class containing CLI tasks and workflow helpers for testing and running Battleship game components.
